text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Crown. ♪ I cannot<n>wait for your
party!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Do ze, do ze! I'm really lookingforward to it, Dia. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But it means this year's "big sister<n>time" is already
coming to an end...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, I never told you about "big sister<n>time", did I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, but I'm guessing it's the time<n>between your
birthday and mine...<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You always take extra good care of<n>me during that
time of year. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, every year around then, you<n>invite me to all
sorts of things. It's<n>really cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's only because you're so<n>helpful to me,
like a big sister! I<n>wanted to repay you...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to pout! I'm already<n>excited for it
again next year, so be<n>my big sister again then,
okay?
